newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank sees no need for rate changes.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank sees no need for rate changes.

text.p: Austrian central bank director Adolf Wala said on Friday there was no prospect of a change in key interest rates, domestic news agency APA reported.
"Interest rate levels in Austria will most likely remain stable in the foreseeable future, just like those in Germany," Wala was quoted as saying.

Austria's discount rate is at a historical low of 2.50 percent, while the Lombard emergency borrowing rate stands at 4.75 percent. Its Gomex money market rate is at 3.40 percent. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
